title: Skill eval suite review findings
description: Return format for every reviewer dispatched by dx-skill-evals-review.

findings.description: Empty when the reviewer found nothing. Never padded.

eval_id.description: The eval this concerns. Null for a suite-level finding, which is what every gap-hunter finding is.

title.description: The defect in 10 words or fewer.

evidence.description: A quote. For answer-in-the-skill, quote BOTH the eval prompt and the skill passage that answers it. A finding with no quote is not reportable.

why_it_matters.description: What a run that passes this eval fails to tell you.

proposed_fix.description: For REWRITE and ADD, the prompt you propose. For MERGE, which eval survives and why. Omitted for CUT.

confidence.description: 100 provable by quoting two passages. 75 likely, a charitable reading could reconcile it. 50 advisory. Below 50, suppress the finding rather than emitting it.

notes.description: What you could not assess, and why. Never a summary of the findings above.
